adjudication.rationale: The pagination logic added in `admin-group.js.es6` is incorrect and can produce an extra empty page when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`. Specifically, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (and similarly `currentPage`), so with `user_count=50` and `limit=50` it yields `totalPages=2` instead of `1`. The `next` action then sets `offset` to `min(offset+limit, user_count)` which becomes `50`, and `Group.findMembers` clamps `offset` to `user_count` and requests `/members.json?offset=50`, returning an empty `members` list. The diff also adds no tests covering these boundary conditions (the added Ruby specs cover controller actions, not client pagination), so this defect would not be caught.
